states.name: OFF
states.description: No demand; pump commands false; served cleared after falling-edge handling.

states.name: DEMAND
states.description: Demand true; run healthy preferred pump or healthy fallback; latch served if a pump runs.

actions: IF fallingEdge AND served THEN LeadA_State := NOT LeadA_State END_IF
IF PumpCmdA OR PumpCmdB THEN served := TRUE END_IF
IF PumpCmdA OR PumpCmdB THEN served := TRUE END_IF
IF fallingEdge AND served THEN LeadA_State := NOT LeadA_State END_IF

state_machine.SelectHealthyPump: IF scanDemand THEN IF LeadA_State THEN IF NOT scanFaultA THEN PumpCmdA:=TRUE; PumpCmdB:=FALSE ELSIF NOT scanFaultB THEN PumpCmdA:=FALSE; PumpCmdB:=TRUE ELSE PumpCmdA:=FALSE; PumpCmdB:=FALSE END_IF ELSE IF NOT scanFaultB THEN PumpCmdA:=FALSE; PumpCmdB:=TRUE ELSIF NOT scanFaultA THEN PumpCmdA:=TRUE; PumpCmdB:=FALSE ELSE PumpCmdA:=FALSE; PumpCmdB:=FALSE END_IF END_IF ELSE PumpCmdA:=FALSE; PumpCmdB:=FALSE END_IF

timer_plan.reset_conditions: No timers used. Non-timer scan state: served resets FALSE on Demand=FALSE; previous_demand is set to sampled Demand each scan; LeadA_State toggles only on fallingEdge AND served.

priorities: Safety: never energize a pump while its fault input is TRUE.
Safety: no demand forces PumpA and PumpB OFF.
Safety: at most one pump command may be active.
Operational: with demand, run the preferred healthy lead; if the lead is faulted, run the healthy standby; if both are faulted, run neither.
State: toggle LeadA only on the falling edge of a demand episode that latched served TRUE; toggle at most once per served episode.
State: served latches TRUE whenever any pump runs during Demand and clears on Demand FALSE; previous_demand tracks sampled Demand every scan.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample Demand, FaultA, FaultB once into scanDemand, scanFaultA, scanFaultB. Compute fallingEdge := previous_demand AND NOT scanDemand. Do not write outputs.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Apply no-demand reset first: if NOT scanDemand, force PumpCmdA/PumpCmdB false; if fallingEdge AND served, toggle LeadA_State; clear served. If scanDemand, select healthy pump using LeadA_State and faults; latch served if PumpCmdA OR PumpCmdB. Update previous_demand := scanDemand after using fallingEdge. Retain updated state for next scan; LeadA reflects post-transition LeadA_State.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.actions: No timer function blocks exist; this stage is a no-op. If timers are added later, call all timer FBs here unconditionally, outside CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Assign outputs once: PumpA := PumpCmdA; PumpB := PumpCmdB; LeadA := LeadA_State. No other output writes in the scan.
